summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC, as depositor for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-D, filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated November 3, 2026 with Hyundai Capital America and BNP Paribas Securities Corp. as underwriter representative, covering $1,997,210,000 aggregate principal of Class A-1, A-2-A, A-2-B, A-3, A-4, B and C auto-loan asset-backed notes. Closing is expected on or about November 10, 2026. Ancillary documents include the receivables purchase agreement, amended trust agreement, sale and servicing agreement and indenture. This is a routine ABS takedown, not a special situation; watch spread pricing and collateral performance rather than event arbitrage.
